nodes.label: Canonical Model Layer Stack
nodes.rationale: Documents the layer stack (Frontend -> Canonical Model -> Frappe Mapping -> Business Behaviour -> Relationships -> Workflow -> Stock/Accounting/Tax Impact -> API Behaviour -> Permissions -> ERPNext Source Reference -> Behavioral Tests -> Future Native Backend) that docs/backend/ follows, distinct from the deployment/runtime layered architecture in docs/architecture.md.

nodes.label: MFG-VAL-006 Quality Readiness rule
nodes.rationale: Quality Readiness must read Job Card's own quality_inspection_template/quality_inspection fields, never fall back to the production Item's own template default, since that would infer Work-Order-level readiness from an unrelated Item-level setting; deliberate design choice, distinct from mcp-server's own Item-level approach for a different purpose.

nodes.label: MFG-STK-001 fg_completed_qty gate
nodes.rationale: ERPNext's Stock Entry.update_work_order only calls add_additional_items()/update_work_order_qty() when fg_completed_qty is truthy; omitting it let a Stock Entry submit cleanly while silently never attaching the additional item to required_items. Fixed by threading preview.fg_completed_qty through the form and validating presence before submit.

nodes.label: MFG-STK-002 Additional material lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Submitting an extra non-BOM item line calls add_additional_items(), inserting a Work Order Item row with is_additional_item=1 and voucher_detail_reference, bypassing the update-after-submit block because it is a targeted server-side child-row insert, not doc.save(). Cancelling calls remove_additional_items().

nodes.label: MFG-STK-003 Quantity headroom
nodes.rationale: Total transferable qty per item is capped at required_qty * (1 + Manufacturing Settings.transfer_extra_materials_percentage/100), currently 0% on this instance; live-confirmed rejection of a 200-unit excess transfer.

nodes.label: MFG-VAL-004 Warehouse validity server-side
nodes.rationale: ERPNext independently rejects a group warehouse server-side even though the frontend's warehouse picker already filters to is_group=0, disabled=0.

nodes.label: MFG-WF-003 Draft never moves stock
nodes.rationale: Only Submit moves stock; a Draft Material Transfer for Manufacture Stock Entry leaves Bin.actual_qty and transferred_qty unchanged, so the frontend exposes saveTransferDraftAction and submitTransferAction as two separate actions rather than one implicit save-and-submit.

nodes.label: MFG-VAL-005 Batch/serial guard
nodes.rationale: Frontend-only safety: rows whose item has has_batch_no/has_serial_no are disabled in the form since no batch/serial picker UI exists yet; not an ERPNext-enforced block at this step.
